findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (rotation_period is unset, so rotation is disabled). Without rotation, a single key encrypts the audit bucket's data indefinitely, so any compromise of the key material retains long-lived decryption capability over all audit logs.

deletion_window_in_days is set to 7, the minimum. If this key is destroyed (accidentally or by an attacker with Terraform/IAM access), the audit-trail data encrypted under it becomes permanently unrecoverable after only a week, limiting the window to detect and reverse a destructive key deletion targeting audit records.
